Activation.description: One append-only package activation ledger row.

runtimeRole.description: Present for ledgers that retain the PostgreSQL runtime user.

ActivationEffects.description: The Casework-specific effects of an activation.

ActivationPlan.description: What `caseworkctl plan` reports. It is read in a read-only transaction.

changesPending.description: Whether apply would record an activation.

effects.description:
Absent when the schema is too old to read before migrating, or when
the runtime role lacks SELECT on a Casework table until apply
reissues its grants.

runtimeRoleMode.description:
The role mode the planning connection's authority gives it, absent
when it cannot see the ledger yet. `caseworkctl plan` connects with
the runtime credential, so this is the runtime role's mode.

schemaVersion.description: The newest applied schema version, or none on an empty database.

ActivationRefusal.description:
One reason an activation is refused, with the location the operator
corrects and the next command.

roleMode.description: The role mode this connection has, absent before the first apply.

CheckScope.description: A source file relative to the project and the resource path a check reports.

path.description: A pointer whose list positions use existing unique identifiers when available.

ClockPolicy.description: The serialized form of [`ClockPolicy`]: the shape the serializer emits.

DatabaseIdCheck.description: How a configured deployment identity compares with the ledger.

Diagnostic.description:
One problem, in the shape every checking command reports (CFG-DIAG-1).

Messages name keys, paths, accepted values, bounds, and the expected
envelope without repeating rejected scalar values (CFG-SEC-3). Warning
acceptance metadata separately identifies the resource and carries the
project's deliberately authored reason.

acceptedReason.description: The project's reason for accepting this advisory warning.

artifact.description:
The document's `kind`, or the expected kind when the document's own is
absent or wrong and the reader expected exactly one.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the document as written; `""` is the root.

scope.description: Project-relative identity copied into a check acceptance.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable display text. Bidirectional embedding, override, and isolate controls, byte-order marks, line and paragraph separators, and Unicode noncharacters are refused; multilingual joiners and direction marks remain valid.

ElapsedDuration.description: An elapsed budget in exactly one unit; a day is 24 elapsed hours.

EnforcementLayer.description:
One place the runtime can refuse an event, in execution order within
`LifecycleDescription::enforcement`. `events` names every event the layer
runs for; an event absent from the list passes the layer without being
checked there. Where an event is raised on more than one path and the layer
gates only some of them, the description says which. One list can report one
order, so where a layer's position is not the one a particular event meets,
that layer's description names the event and where it really runs.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

guard.description:
What the state machine itself checks before it moves the state. Nothing
the runtime checks around it appears here; that is `enforcement`.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

PinnedWorkEffect.description: The pinned-work verdict an activation reaches.

PlanKind.description: Whether an activation is the database's first or follows another.

ProducerRetention.description: How long Casework keeps what a producer needs to recover a submission.

receiptRetentionDays.description: Days a submission receipt stays readable for recovery, at most 365.

ProjectIdentity.description:
The members that name a project (CFG-ENV-6): a project's `project` block
holds these, and may add project-wide members of the product's own.
Schema name `ProjectIdentity`.

mutationPolicy.x-registry-passthrough: A bounded mutationPolicy fragment from the closed BReg project format; bregctl remains its format owner.

yaml.x-registry-passthrough: A bounded YAML fragment from the closed BReg authoring format; bregctl remains its format owner.
A bounded YAML fragment from the closed BReg authoring format; bregctl remains its format owner.

Related.description:
A second place that explains a diagnostic, such as the first occurrence
of a duplicate. Human output prints it as a `note:` line.

id.description: The producer-issued contract id, kept exactly as written: nonblank, no control characters, and at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. The byte ceiling is enforced by the Casework reader.

oneOf.description: A rejection or change request settles the whole review immediately.
A negative decision counts toward this stage and the review continues.

publicReason.description:
Whether a decision with this outcome gives text for release to the
subject's owner. There is no default: the policy author decides what
an applicant is told.

ReviewPolicyDependencies.description:
Complete behavioral inputs retained beside an admitted request. Live Directory
membership and absence facts remain current authority, not policy inputs.

initiatorProfile.description:
The requester profile a person named as this producer's initiator
authenticates with to read the requester-visible history of their own
requests. Absent, no initiator reads anything.

ReviewPublicReasonRule.description: Whether a decision gives a public reason with an outcome.

RoleMode.description: Whether the runtime credential can write the activation ledger.

RoutingPredicate.description:
The written form of [`RoutingPredicate`], an externally tagged union the
shared reader decodes with positions.

oneOf.description: The projected field equals this value.
The projected field equals one of these values.

label.description: Optional presentation label. Stable references use `id`.

SchedulingTaskPermission.description:
Exact Scheduling commitment authority copied into a task grant.

This duplicates the public wire shape deliberately: Casework is an
authority for governed templates, not a dependency on Scheduling's runtime
or model crate.

Severity.description: Whether a diagnostic refuses the input.

Source.description:
Where a diagnostic points. `file` is the path exactly as the caller gave
it; `line` and `column` are 1-based and absent when the problem concerns
the file as a whole.

StageClockAnchor.description: The instant a stage clock counts from: `anchor: {type: stage-entered}`.

SubjectClockAnchor.description: The instant a subject clock counts from: `anchor: {type: request-accepted}`.

TaskGrantBounds.description:
The product-specific authority a task grant carries, chosen by its `type`
member. The shared reader's union helper decodes it so every error inside
a variant keeps its position (CFG-SCHEMA-8); the wire form is unchanged.

authorizationMode.description:
Immediate authorizations last at most fifteen minutes. Deferred is an
explicit governed window of at most seven days; assertion TTL stays sixty seconds.

evidenceContext.description:
Evidence-only requester context signed into the authority assertion.
Other products derive neither requester admission nor relying-party
audience from these fields and therefore forbid the block entirely.

reviewPolicies.description: Policies whose currently held ReviewTasks may issue this grant.

subjects.description:
Exact token identity keys mapped to governed source logical fields.
Values are extracted from the approving caller's disclosed source read.

TemplateAgent.description:
The agent a template names, as `casework.yaml` writes it: the issuer is
the URL of the token issuer that authenticates the agent (CFG-VAL-7).

TemplateChange.description: What an activation does to one task template version.

oneOf.description: The version is stored for the first time and becomes active.
A stored inactive version becomes active again.

An active version the package no longer declares is deactivated and
its live grants are invalidated.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host preserved as written, no user information, and no backslash, whitespace or control character. DNS case and equivalent IPv6 literals are permitted.

WorkingDays.description:
A number of working days: `after: {workingDays: N}`, and the lead time
inside `before`.

WorkingDaysBefore.description: A lead time before a stage clock is due: `{before: {workingDays: N}}`.

check.x-registry-passthrough: The existing typed caseworkctl check payload is embedded unchanged.

package.x-registry-passthrough: The existing typed caseworkctl package payload is embedded unchanged.

pairing.x-registry-passthrough: The existing typed caseworkctl provider-pair agreement payload is embedded unchanged.
